body:
Cassowary CR 1/2

This large colorful-headed bird is shaped like an ostrich with a ridge on its head.

XP 200
N Medium animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 6 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee claw +4 (1d4+2)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 6
Base Attack +0; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +3 (+9 when jumping), Perception +5; Racial Modifiers +6 Acrobatics when jumping

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical forests
Organization solitary, pair
Treasure none

Solitary creatures, cassowaries are tropical omnivores that eat fruit and other food of opportunity. They are flightless birds similar to emus and ostriches.
